translation.name: Dižaʼ chaweʼ kub len Salmo kaʼ

book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: DIŽA' NEŽW DA' BSEḺA' PABLO ḺO YEŽ CORINTO

content: Kan gok, bebán Benne' Cristo ḻo yeḻa' got
Na'a, ẕí'na'do' ka', wzenla' ḻe'e kan nak diža' chawen' da' bchaḻja' gan zoale, dan' wẕí' ḻo na'le, na' žonen ga nakže ḻi ḻaže' kan žejḻe'le che Benne' Criston'.
Ni'a che dižan' yelale, cha' gonle kan ẕnna diža' chawen' dan' bchaḻjan' gan zoale, cha' da' li bejḻe'le che Benne' Criston'.

Kate' bžina' gan zoale da' nežw chi'i bdia' ḻo na'le da' bde Dios ḻo na'a neda'. Ki ẕnnan: “Got Benne' Criston' ḻo wlazžo žo'o dan' wbága'žo doḻa'.” Kan nak da' ni nyejw ḻe'e yiche la'y, na' ẕnnan ben byenen benen'.
Ḻezka' ẕnnan: “Bgache'e ḻo yežw ba, na' kate' bza'a chonne ža, na' bebane' ḻo yeḻa' got” kan ḻezka' nyejw ḻe'e yiche la'y, na' ẕnnan ben byenen goken chie'.
Wdé bebane' bḻoe'e ḻaw Benne' Criston', na' Bedon' bḻe'ele' Ḻe', na' wdé na', benne' chežinno wbás chie' ka' bḻé'egekle' Ḻe'.

Naž Benne' Criston' bḻoe'e ḻawe' ḻawgak benne' zanže ka gayo' gaywá' lježžo ka', benne' ka' žejḻé'gake' chie' Ḻe', kate' ne zej ndobe' tẕen. Yógo'te lježžo ki nníta'gake' nbángake' na'a, ḻa'kze baḻe' ba gótgake'.
Naž Jakob bḻe'ele' Ḻe', na' wdé na' bḻoe'e ḻawe' ḻawgak yógo'te benne' wbás chie' ka'.
Kate' ze ḻawte ḻezka' bḻoe'e ḻawe' ḻawa' neda'. Kan gok da' ni, naka' ka to x̱kwide' goljbe' kate' ba wdé ža žaḻa' galjbe'.
Ki naken dan' nex̱jwa' neda' ka yógo'te benne' wbás chie' ka', na' bi naka' neda' zi gaka' wbás chie', dan' wžía ḻaža'a benách ka' che Dios.

Na'a, ni'a che da' besbaga' Dios neda', naka' da' naka' na'a, na' kege da' nitze bene' chia' ki. Benža' neda' x̱chine' ka yezika' wbás chie' ka', ḻa'kze kege žakze chia' bena' žin na'. Dios na'kze, ḻo yeḻa' ži'i ḻaže' chie', bkonle' neda' žin.
Na'a, cha' bchaḻja' neda' o cha' bchaḻjgak yebaḻe benne' ka', da' ni naken da' ẕchaḻjton', na' da' bejḻe'le ḻe'e.
Yebanžo ḻo yeḻa' got
Ẕzoa lito' che Benne' Criston' kan bebane' ḻo yeḻa' got. Cha' ki naken, ¿nakx̱kze ẕnnale báḻele ḻe'e: “Bi yebangak benne' gat ka'?”
Chela' bi yebangak benne' gat ka', bi bebán Benne' Criston',
na' chela' bi bebán Benne' Criston', dáche'ze nak da' ẕzoa lito', na' dáche'ze nak yeḻa' žejḻé' chele chie' Ḻe'.
Ḻezka', chela' bi bebán Benne' Criston', žon ḻáže'to' kate' ẕzoa lito' kan nak che Dios, na' ẕnnato' besbane' Benne' Criston'. Chela' bi yesbane' benne' gat ka', Dios bi besbane' Benne' Criston'.
Chela' bi yebangak benne' gat ka', bi bebán Benne' Criston',
na' chela' bi bebán Benne' Criston', dáche'ze nak yeḻa' žejḻé' chele chie' Ḻe', na' zej nga'n doḻa' da' nbága'le.
Ḻezka', benne' ka' ba gótgake', na' bejḻé'gake' che Benne' Criston', to chi'ize gótgake' cha' bi bebane' Ḻe'.
Cha' toze kate' ne zoažo nbanžo gak yebéḻenlžo Benne' Criston', nakže da' nyache' chežo ka da' nak chegak yógo'te benách ka'.
Na'a, da' li bebán Benne' Criston' ḻo yeḻa' got, na' nake' Benne' nežw, bennen' bebane' to chi'ize ládjwgak yógo'te benne' ka' yebángake' to chi'ize ḻo yeḻa' got.
Kan bḻa' yeḻa' got ni'a che da' ben to benne', ḻezka', ni'a che da' ben yetó benne' bḻa' yeḻa' yebán chegak benne' gat ka'.
Kan žatgak yógo'te benách ka' dan' zej nake' ẕa'só Adán, ḻezka' yebangak yógo'te benne' ka' zej nake' toze ḻen Benne' Criston'.
To toe' yebane' kan žaḻa' gaken. Zga'ale bebán Benne' Criston', na' te na'a yebangak benne' ka' zej nake' chie' Ḻe' katen' yeḻé'e.
Naž žin ža ze ḻawte ža kate' yeká' Benne' Criston' dot da' yo'o ḻo na' da' x̱iwe', na' dot yeḻa' wnná bia' chen, na' dot yeḻa' wak chen, na' wdíe' da' ẕnna bi'e Ḻe' ḻo na' X̱ažo Dios.
Žon byenen nna bia' Benne' Criston' na' zejte ža ba bzoa Dios kate' yógo'te benne' ka', benne' ẕží'igake' chie' Ḻe', wzóa ẕíbgake' ḻawe' Ḻe'.
Da' ẕdá'baga' Ḻe', da' wchinnje' kate' ze ḻawte, naken yeḻa' got.

Dios ba bdie' yógo'te ḻo na' Ẕi'nen' nich nna bi'en. Nyejw ḻe'e yiche la'y da' ẕnnan: “Bdie' yógo'te ḻo ne'e nich nna bi'en.” Na'a, nak bia' bi bde kwine' ḻo na' Ẕi'nen', dan' nakkze' Ḻe' Bennen' ẕdie' yógo'ten ḻo na' Ẕi'nen'.

Kate' žin ža na' kate' wdé Dios yógo'ten ḻo na' Benne' Criston' nich nna bi'en, naž Ẕi'nen' wdé kwine' ḻo na' X̱ažo Dios, Bennen' bdie' ḻo na' Ẕi'nen' yógo'ten, na' kate' ze ḻawte, Dios nna bi'e to chi'ize yógo'ten.
Báḻele ḻe'e žezoale nis ḻo wlazgak benne' gat ka'. Cha' žéklele bi yebangak benne' gat ka', ¿biẕ chen' žezoale nis ḻo wlazgak benne' gat ka'?
Žon ẕož cheto' gatto' yógo'te ža. ¿Biẕ chen' žwe'to' latje gaken ki cha' bi yebanžo ḻo yeḻa' got?
Yógo'te ža žon ẕož gata'. Ẕzenla' ḻe'e da' ni, ljéža'do' ka', dan' žaz ḻaža'a da' bena'. Bena' ga žejḻe'le che X̱anžo Jesús, Benne' Criston'.
Cha' bdíḻ-ḻena' bia snia ka' ḻo yež Éfeso dan' wnnazen chia', ¿biẕkze yebéḻenla'? Cha' bi yebangak benne' gat ka', žaḻa' gonžo kan ẕnnagak benách ka': “Ye'j gawžo dan' gatžo wx̱é wižj.”
Bi we'le latje no benne' gon ḻáže'le' ḻe'e. Cha' si' ḻo na'le láte'ze da' wen ḻaže', na' dotle yechóḻele.
Le yeyát ḻaže', na' biž gonle doḻa' dan' báḻele ḻe'e bi nónbia'le Dios. Ẕchaḻja' ki nich gona' ga yedoé'elele.
Kan gakžo kate' yebanžo ḻo yeḻa' got
Wákelja no benne' nne': “¿Nakx̱kze yebangak benne' gat ka'? ¿Nakx̱kze gak beḻa' žen chégake' kate' yeḻá'gake'?”
Le', benne' bi nnezle. Da' žazo' ḻo yo bi ḻan' cha' bi nitlen.
Da'žazo' ḻo yo naken to bínnedo'ze, cha' che ẕoa' stribe, o che yetó yix̱e' kwando'. Dan' žazo' bi naken yix̱e' kwando' da' žaḻa' ḻan'.
Dios žone' ga gak to to yix̱e' kwando' kan nonkze' chen. Kan nak to to bínnedo' ka' žone' ga gak yix̱e' kwando' chen.

Ḻezka', bi nak toze kan nak beḻa' che chegak yógo'te bia yix̱e' ka'. Zoa to beḻa' chegak benne' ka', na' yetó kan nak beḻa' chegak bia yix̱e' ka'. Yetó kan nak beḻa' chegak byinne ka', na' yetó kan nak beḻa' chegak bel ka'.

Ḻezka' nža' beḻa' žen chegak benne' ka' nníta'gake' ya'abá che Dios ka nak beḻa' žen chegak benne' ka' zej nnite'e yežlyó nga. Zoa to yeḻa' x̱tan chegak benne' ka' zej nnite'e ya'abá che Dios, na' yetó kan nak yeḻa' x̱tan chegak benne' ka' nníta'gake' yežlyó nga.
Zoa to yeḻa' x̱tan che wbíž, na' yetó che byo', na' yetó chegak belj ya'abá ka'. Yeḻa' x̱tan che to belj ya'abá nžan' kan nak yeḻa' x̱tan che yetó belj ya'abá.
Ḻezka' gaken kate' yebangak benne' gat ka'. Kate' ẕgache' to benne' ḻo yežw ba nake' to beḻa' žen da' kwia yin'. Kate' yebane', naž gake' to da' soan to chi'ize.
Kate' ẕgache'e ḻo yežw ba nake' to beḻa' žen ka'ze, na' da' ẕkwíde'len. Kate' yebane', naž gake' to da' x̱tan, na' da' waḻe.
Kate' ẕgache'e ḻo yežw ba nake' to beḻa' žen che yežlyó nga. Kate' yebane', naž gake' to da' soan to chi'ize ya'abá che Dios. Zoa to beḻa' žen che yežlyó nga, na' yetó kan gak da' cho'o be' nakkzžo.

Nyejw ḻe'e yiche la'y da' ẕnnan: “Benne' nežw, benne' wzóe' yežlyó nga, bennen' lie' Adán, Dios bene' ḻe' benne' ban” san Bennen' wyaze' latje che Adán na', Benne' Criston', Dios bene' ga nake' Be' nbánḻenžo.
Bi bḻa' zga'ale Benne' nake' Be'. Bḻa' zga'ale bennen' wdape' yeḻa' benachze chežo, na' naž bḻa' Benne' nake' Be'.
Bennen' wzóe' zga'ale', goke' yo. Bennen' bežope', Bennen' nake' X̱anžon', bžoje' ya'abá che Dios.
Benne' ka' nníta'gake' yežlyó nga zej nake' kan gok bennen' goke' yo, na' benne' ka' žaḻa' chejnníta'gake' ya'abá che Dios gákgake' kan nak Bennen' bžoje' ya'abá na' che Dios.
Kan de chežo na'a to beḻa' žen da' naken kan gok beḻa' žen che bennen' goke' yo, ḻezka' žaḻa' yeyakžo kan nak Bennen' bžoje' ya'abá na' che Dios.
Ki ẕnna da' ni da' žapa' ḻe'e, ẕí'na'do' ka', ẕnnia': da' naken beḻa' žen bi chazen gan ẕnna bia' Dios, na' ḻezka', da' kwia yin' bi sin' da' zoan to chi'ize.
Le wia nga, žapa' ḻe'e to da' bgachen': bi gatžo yógo'težo, san Dios wché'e kan nakžo yógo'težo.

To chí'ido'ze gaken, kan nak to da' ẕdaze yej ḻawžo, kate' kwež lozban' da' ẕze ḻawten. Kwež lozban', na' yebangak benne' gat ka', na' gákgake' to da' soan to chi'ize, na' Dios wché'e da' nakžo yógo'težo žo'o.
Da' nakžo da' kwia yin' žaḻa' yeyaken to da' soan to chi'ize, na' da' nakžo, dan' žaḻa' gaten, yeyaken to da' batkle gaten.
Katen' dan' kwia yin' ba beyaken to da' soan to chi'ize, na' ḻezka' dan' žaḻa' gaten ba beyaken to da' batkle gaten, naž gak dan' nyejw ḻe'e yiche la'y da' ẕnnan:

content.text: Biž bi gak gon yeḻa' got chežo.

content: Wak bi gon yeḻa' got chežo dan' nbága'žo doḻa', na' nbága'žo doḻa' dan' ẕži'ižo che x̱tiža' Dios.
Žox̱ken Dios. Ḻe' benkze' ga belažo ḻo yeḻa' got ni'a che da' ben X̱anžo Jesús, Benne' Criston'.
Che ḻen, ẕí'na'do' ka', le soa choch. Le gak dot ḻi ḻaže' nich góntezle x̱chin X̱anžon' dan' nnézkzelele žin da' žonle che X̱anžon' bi naken dáche'ze.
